cohort: The study included all live births in France between 2012 and 2020, totaling over 6 million mothers.
finding: Infants of women with pre-gestational diabetes (T1DM or T2DM) had significantly higher incidences of congenital heart defects compared to infants of women without pre-gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of congenital heart defects.
